events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.region: Quay County; Curry County; Roosevelt County; De Baca County
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
At 313 PM MST, Doppler radar was tracking a line of strong
thunderstorms extending from 6 miles southwest of Quay to 12 miles
southwest of Taiban, moving east at 25 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph and pea size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor damage to outdoor objects is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Fort Sumner, House, Tolar, Taiban, Ragland, Mcalister and Forrest.

This includes Highway 60 between Mile Markers 329 and 361.

events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.region: Middle Rio Grande Valley/Albuquerque Metro Area; Sandia/Manzano Mountains Including Edgewood
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
At 258 PM MST, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm over
Sandia Heights, or 8 miles northeast of Albuquerque, moving east at
25 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 40 mph and pea size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor damage to outdoor objects is
possible. Hail may accumulate on roadways causing hazardous
travel.

Locations impacted include...
Northeastern Albuquerque, Tijeras, Cedar Crest, Sandia Park, Sandia
Heights, Sedillo, Carnuel, Canoncito in Bernalillo County and San
Antonito.

This includes the following highways...
Interstate 40 between Mile Markers 159 and 183. Interstate 25 between
Mile Markers 224 and 234.

events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.region: Atka and Adak
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Southwest winds 45 to 60 mph with gusts up to 75 mph
possible.

* WHERE...Atka and Adak.

* WHEN...From late Monday night through Tuesday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...High winds could move loose debris, damage property, and
cause power outages. Travel could be difficult.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Adak could see the strongest wind gusts of 75
mph with Atka winds potentially gusting to 60 mph. Winds rapidly
increase in strength late Monday evening and peak late Tuesday
morning as a strong low pressure system moves through the Bering.
Winds will gradually lighten but remain gusty through Wednesday.
